text: Old kitchen window violently slammed open by a gust of wind, loud bang, glass rattling, storm rushing in
Heavy rain and wind pouring through an open window at night, a lace curtain flapping
Old light bulb suddenly turning on by itself with an electrical clunk, buzzing hum and flicker
Light bulb bursting, sharp electrical pop and small glass shatter, then silence
Slow heavy footsteps walking on the floor upstairs heard through the ceiling, wooden creaks, muffled
